ratios.quote: We were in compliance with all covenants under the Credit Agreement as of June 30, 2026 (the net leverage ratio was 0.53 to 1.00 compared to a maximum net leverage ratio of 3.25 to 1.00 on a quarterly basis covering the trailing four consecutive fiscal quarters for each fiscal quarter).

parsed.notes: Maximum net leverage ratio of 3.25x may step up to 3.75x for a period following material acquisitions; it was 3.25x as of June 30, 2026. Tested quarterly on a trailing four-quarter basis. No borrowings were outstanding under the revolver.
